signature.name: Survives without the extras
signature.description: Does the page still work with JavaScript disabled and before web fonts load, and is the file lean?

group-a.signature_why: 3.7KB; hours, headline and all three links are static HTML; JS only fills a status line and path; fonts swap but layout holds.
group-a.loved: Everything essential is plain HTML, so with JS off you still get headline, hours and links, and the file is tiny.
group-a.docked: Space Mono to monospace swap will shift the layout, there is a placeholder path with JS off, and the ticket sits oddly empty at 1280.

group-b.signature_why: 3.9KB, Georgia body means little font shift; no-JS leaves static hours but the loaf shows a stray ? and 'You asked for: /'.
group-b.loved: Georgia-first body text and a static status line make the page legible before fonts or script arrive.
group-b.docked: With JS off the loaf says '?' and the echoed path is wrong; the loaf art pushes below the links and feels flat.

group-c.signature_why: 5KB, but the hours table is built entirely by JS so 'Full week' jumps to an empty Hours section with JS off; Caveat swap is visible.
group-c.loved: Hours line is static HTML and the paper concept is strong and reads well on a phone.
group-c.docked: JS-only hours table leaves a dead Full week link without JS, and the pencil strike covers the echoed path so it is barely legible.
